title: Second Conditional: Unreal and Unlikely Situations
explanation: Use if + past simple, would + base verb for situations that are not real or are unlikely now: If I had more money, I would travel. After if, use were for all persons in advice: If I were you, I would ask for help. The past simple here does not talk about the past: it shows that the situation is imaginary.
explanationPersian: از ساختار if + گذشتهٔ ساده، would + فعل ساده برای موقعیت‌های غیرواقعی یا بعید در زمان حال استفاده کن: If I had more money, I would travel. در توصیه بعد از if برای همهٔ فاعل‌ها were به کار می‌رود: If I were you, I would ask for help. گذشتهٔ ساده اینجا دربارهٔ گذشته نیست؛ نشان می‌دهد موقعیت خیالی است.
